title: Weak Poincaré inequalities for two-component Deterministic-scan Metropolis-within-Gibbs samplers
summary: Using the framework of weak Poincaré inequalities, we analyze the convergence properties of deterministic-scan Metropolis-within-Gibbs samplers, an important class of Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms. Our analysis applies to nonreversible Markov chains and yields explicit (subgeometric) convergence bounds through novel comparison techniques based on Dirichlet forms. We show that the joint chain inherits the convergence behavior of the marginal chain and conversely.
